## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: Four test helper files use redundant nested command substitution pattern: `echo "$(echo "$out" | tail -1)"` can be simplified to `echo "$out" | tail -1`
Files: tests/scripts/test-ticket-comment.sh, tests/scripts/test-ticket-list.sh, tests/scripts/test-ticket-reducer-batch.sh, tests/scripts/test-ticket-transition.sh
Category: maintainability
data.title: [test-helpers]: redundant nested command substitution in _create_ticket() -> echo "$(echo "$out" | tail -1)"
